an10.86:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Mahākassapo Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
an10.86:1.2: Tatra kho āyasmā Mahākassapo bhikkhū āmantesi :--
an10.86:1.4: Āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Mahākassapassa paccassosuṃ.
an10.86:2.2: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā ti pajānāmī' ti.
an10.86:2.3: Tam enaṃ Tathāgato vā Tathāgatasāvako vā jhāyī samāpattikusalo paracittakusalo paracittapariyāyakusalo samanuyuñjati samanugāhati samanubhāsati.
an10.86:2.4: So Tathāgatena vā Tathāgatasāvakena vā jhāyinā samāpattikusalena paracittakusalena paracittapariyāyakusalena samanuyuñjiyamāno samanugāhiyamāno samanubhāsiyamāno iriṇaṃ āpajjati, vijinaṃ āpajjati, anayaṃ āpajjati, vyasanaṃ āpajjati, anayavyasanaṃ āpajjati.
an10.86:3.1: Tam enaṃ Tathāgato vā Tathāgatasāvako vā jhāyī samāpattikusalo paracittakusalo paracittapariyāyakusalo evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca manasikaroti:
an10.86:3.2: Kin nu kho ayam āyasmā aññaṃ vyākaroti
an10.86:3.3: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā ti pajānāmī' ti?
an10.86:4.1: Tam enaṃ Tathāgato vā Tathāgatasāvako vā jhāyī samāpattikusalo paracittakusalo paracittapariyāyakusalo evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāti:
an10.86:5.1: Adhimāniko kho ayam āyasmā adhimānasacco appatte pattasaññī akate katasaññī anadhigate adhigatasaññī
an10.86:5.3: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā ti pajānāmī' ti.
an10.86:6.1: Tam enaṃ Tathāgato vā Tathāgatasāvako vā jhāyī samāpattikusalo paracittakusalo paracittapariyāyakusalo evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca manasikaroti:
an10.86:6.2: Kin nu kho ayam āyasmā nissāya adhimāniko adhimānasacco appatte pattasaññī akate katasaññī anadhigate adhigatasaññī
an10.86:6.4: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā ti pajānāmī' ti?
an10.86:7.1: Tam enaṃ Tathāgato vā Tathāgatasāvako vā jhāyī samāpattikusalo paracittakusalo paracittapariyāyakusalo evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāti:
an10.86:8.1: ‘Bahussuto kho panāyam āyasmā sutadharo sutasannicayo, ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhe kalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti, tathārūpāssa dhammā bahussutā dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā,
an10.86:8.2: tasmā ayam āyasmā adhimāniko adhimānasacco appatte pattasaññī akate katasaññī anadhigate adhigatasaññī
an10.86:8.4: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā ti pajānāmī' ti.
an10.86:9.1: Tam enaṃ Tathāgato vā Tathāgatasāvako vā jhāyī samāpattikusalo paracittakusalo paracittapariyāyakusalo evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāti:
an10.86:10.3: abhijjhāpariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.86:11.3: vyāpādapariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.86:12.3: thīnamiddhapariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.86:13.3: uddhaccapariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.86:14.3: vicikicchāpariyuṭṭhānaṃ kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.86:15.1: Kammārāmo kho panāyam āyasmā kammarato kammārāmataṃ anuyutto,
an10.86:15.2: kammārāmatā kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.86:16.1: Bhassārāmo kho panāyam āyasmā bhassarato bhassārāmataṃ anuyutto,
an10.86:16.2: bhassārāmatā kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.86:17.1: Niddārāmo kho panāyam āyasmā niddārato niddārāmataṃ anuyutto,
an10.86:17.2: niddārāmatā kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.86:18.1: Saṅgaṇikārāmo kho panāyam āyasmā saṅgaṇikārato saṅgaṇikārāmataṃ anuyutto,
an10.86:18.2: saṅgaṇikārāmatā kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ.
an10.86:19.1: Muṭṭhassati kho panāyam āyasmā uttarikaraṇīye oramattakena visesādhigamena antarāvosānaṃ āpanno,
an10.86:19.2: antarāvosānagamanaṃ kho pana Tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye parihānam etaṃ. 3.
an10.86:20.1: So vatāvuso bhikkhu ime dasa dhamme appahāya imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjissatī ti n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an10.86:20.2: So vatāvuso bhikkhu ime dasa dhamme pahāya imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjissatī ti ṭhānam etaṃ vijjatī
